name: Bartholomew
title: The True Israelite
summary: Bartholomew, likely identical with Nathanael, was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. Philip brought him to Jesus, and Jesus called him 'a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.' He was present at Jesus' revelation by the Sea of Tiberias after the resurrection.

keyEvents.title: Philip's Testimony
keyEvents.description: Philip found Nathanael and told him that they had found the one Moses and the prophets wrote about—Jesus from Nazareth.

keyEvents.title: The Doubt
keyEvents.description: Nathanael asked doubtfully, 'Can anything good come out of Nazareth?' Philip answered, 'Come and see!'

keyEvents.title: A True Israelite
keyEvents.description: Jesus saw Nathanael coming and said, 'See, here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!'

keyEvents.title: Under the Fig Tree
keyEvents.description: When Nathanael asked how Jesus knew him, Jesus answered that he had seen him under the fig tree before Philip called him.

keyEvents.title: By the Sea of Tiberias
keyEvents.description: Nathanael from Cana in Galilee was among the disciples who met the risen Jesus by the Sea of Tiberias.
